    YOUR VIP ROOM

    Your every expectation met and exceeded. Modern colorways and inviting details express your personal brand. Impressive features, like massaging front seats and a premium audio system, create a relaxing vibe in your small electric SUV.

    YOUR RANGE OF POSSIBILITIES

    OPTIQ EV SUV is giving main character energy. From daily commutes to weekend festivals, let your story drive you with an EPA-estimated 317 miles of range* with RWD.

    YOUR DAILY ENDORPHINS

    Press the pedal and OPTIQ, enabled by our battery platform, responds with near-instantaneous torque to the drive wheels. Quick, smooth acceleration pins you to your seat for an athletic driving experience.
